headlines.title: Mike Lindell says he’ll pay for recount after loss in Minnesota governor primary
headlines.description: The MyPillow founder is prepared to pay nearly $1 million to cover the costs associated with a hand recount after he lost to state House Speaker Lisa Demuth.

headlines.title: Prince Harry and Meghan will move back to the United Kingdom, source says
headlines.description: The couple has lived in California since 2020. King Charles was informed of the move Sunday, a source said.

headlines.title: How Sen. Darline Graham’s debate blunder could give undecided voters ‘some pause’
headlines.description: Shelby Talcott, Steve Ricchetti and Ashley Davis join the Meet the Press NOW panel to discuss Sen. Darline Graham’s (R-S.C.) debate performance and key gaps in national security expertise compared to her late brother Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.).

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Democratic candidate for FL governor says Trump is ‘promoting socialism’ as president
headlines.description: Florida gubernatorial candidate and former Republican lawmaker David Jolly (D) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his midterm message as he faces off with Rep. Byron Donald (R) in the general election. Jolly also discusses the rise of democratic socialism within the Democratic Party and where he plans to campaign with Demcoratic Senate candidate Angie Nixon.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Democrats are in their post-resistance era: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump nominates Heidi Overton to lead FDA
headlines.description: Overton, a physician, is a White House aide who often briefs the president on health issues.

headlines.title: New CDC director pledges to ‘speak truth’ about science
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz addressed CDC employees Wednesday in her first agencywide meeting.

headlines.title: Book him: Prosecutors using James Comey’s novel against him in seashells case
headlines.description: Comey’s novel centers on a villain who sends coded messages urging retaliation against his political rivals. In new filings, federal attorneys argue that life imitated art.

headlines.title: San Diego Padres minor-league catching coordinator detained by ICE in Texas
headlines.description: San Diego Padres catching coordinator Oswaldo José Pirela was detained by immigration authorities in El Paso, Texas, and remained in custody, according to family and ICE detainee records.

headlines.title: Trump admin was warned about peeling Reflecting Pool before it brought vandalism case
headlines.description: A National Park Service engineer warned the Trump administration about the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool peeling in early June because of the renovation issues.
